Great food, HORRIBLE manager
Aug 2017 • Solo
I walk into this bbq restaurant off the cuff, wanting something different than pho bo or Cao lau, just some bbq meat is what I wanted. I walk in and the reception is great, I'm ushered to my table, the waitress does her utmost best to help me with my choice. I eventually opt for the buffet menu "smart choice". There were 3 plates of beef displayed & apparently I could have some fish as well. At this point, I'm thinking that I'll be set for the afternoon (3 plates of beef with 4 small pieces of meat & a fish & a salad). After I order a beer, my waitress comes back with, what I think the first of my 3 plates of beef. I eat that, I'm in heaven, it's that good. When I'm finished, is when things get a tad out of hand. At this point another waiter shows up with 4 plates of beef & starts cooking, I'm apprehensive because I'm thinking about where I'll be putting all this food. 5min later my waitress shows up with a whole fish & it's now I'm in red alert cause there's no way I'll be able to finish all this by myself. So I eat 2 more plates of beef and I feel that if I continue I'll start getting sick. So instead of just throwing everything away, I kindly ask if they could wrap the beef & fish up for me, because if I continue I'll be sick. The waiter I asked(his English was better) came back from asking the manager saying they can't do that. I'm a bit surprised, as he can also see that there's a lot left over but he tells me with a smile, no. So I tell him just get the manager I'll explain the situation to them directly. 
The moment the manager is at my table, I explain my situation & she tells me no we can't do that. I tell her, listen if I continue to eat ill be sick, I don't want to be sick while your restaurant is having some kind of birthday party. She smiles at me and say's well you can stay here and continue eating. (now I'm annoyed) I tell her listen, there's half of this menu thing I took left over, if I leave this here it's going g into the bin right? She affirms that, so I tell her if that's the case I might as well just pay half then(I knew this wouldn't take, but she was annoying), she declined. It's at this point I point blank said "well I'm not leaving this if paying in full & the moment I get sick, I'll be sick right in the middle of your restaurant. I doubt your other clients would appreciate that. She just smiles and says well you can eat slowly". 
I can understand that this my sound petty, but I'll finish this beef & fish right here & so help me god I'll vomit in the middle of her restaurant,I'll then go down pay my bill and leave. She'll have to deal with great pr of having a foreigner vomit in her restaurant & I'll be on my way home. 

So, if it's for the food, most definitely pay a visit to sumoBbq(it's a bit pricey, but worth it), but don't come for hospitality.
